Dried Sour Pomegranate Arils (With Seeds)

Tufan Organik Dried Sour Pomegranate Arils (With Seeds) belongs to the Dried Fruits range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

حبوب الرمان الحامض المجففة (بالبذور)

Getrocknete saure Granatapfelkerne (mit Kernen)
